note.en: Closed-shell occupied-orbital RHF equations include nonlocal exchange. Preserve existing He local-reduction and H2RHF examples. note.en: Representative local Kohn–Sham equations. Published examples cover spin-unpolarized exchange-only Dirac LDA for spherical helium and LDA exchange plus VWN5 correlation for fixed periodic He/He₂ cells. The radial atomic implementation and periodic PySCF workflows are separate series with different bases, boundaries and references. Inspect each input and validation record below; these examples do not validate GGA, hybrids, general materials or excited states.

note.ja: 固定核・非相対論の電子固有値問題。核間反発は電子Hamiltonianの外に加える。従来の水素型動径例を保持し、追加は1次元の箱/HOと3AO以下の2電子FCIに限定する。一般多電子系の直接解法や連続空間の厳密分子解の検証ではない。
note.en: Fixed-nuclei nonrelativistic electronic eigenproblems; add nuclear repulsion separately. Preserve the existing hydrogenic radial examples. Additional examples are restricted to one-dimensional box/HO and two-electron FCI in at most3AOs, not general many-electron direct solvers or continuum-exact molecules.
